timing_and_integrity.scope: This literature note does not repair prior study blinding, alter a fixed gate, or establish an experimental result.

reused_note.prior_findings_reused: Adaptive triggers, cumulative cost accounting, shorter-view acceptance and incremental summary maintenance already overlap with prior work. This review adds closer state-retention and cost-trigger comparisons.

target_under_comparison.E: After already-dispatched actor calls with known terminal usage, accumulate max(0, native(full actual actor input) - native(the same input with only newly eligible raw prefix removed)). Prior summary, system/task, recent tail, tools and budget context remain in the count-only view; no counterfactual view is dispatched.
target_under_comparison.C: Latest known paid focus logical input plus output. A known paid invalid or nonshrinking focus still updates C and resets E. Unsent opportunities do neither; unknown usage stops the task.
target_under_comparison.trigger: First opportunity retains the shared length trigger. Repeat offer uses E >= C subject to frozen freshness, retention and maximum-two-opportunity rules; no current unsent or predicted future charge is added.
target_under_comparison.representation: Only the eligible second opportunity, after first-summary acceptance, can append a delta while retaining the prior note bytes. Full combined-view native shortening and size/context/budget constraints still apply.
target_under_comparison.excluded_novelty: Explicitly asking for a JSON object is output-contract clarification, not a new compaction or memory algorithm.

bounded_search.selection: One pinned official memory implementation and its documentation, one official compaction cookbook, and three primary papers about summarization or end-to-end memory/compression cost.
bounded_search.discovery_limit: The first four search queries returned mixed domains; nonprimary results were not opened or used. Subsequent seven queries used primary-domain filters. No broad citation-chain or whole-repository survey was performed.
blocked_or_unverified: OpenReview OHVzruJl5k PDF was blocked; later-version hybrid-method search snippets were not treated as verified evidence. The reviewed Complexity Trap evidence is arXiv v1 only.
Anthropic notebook main link did not render substantive code in the browser; conclusions use the official rendered cookbook, whose revision was not pinned.
Mastra commit fixes the inspected bytes, not historical publication priority. Commit history and prior-art dates were not audited.

primary_sources.title: Mastra Observational Memory
viewed_scope: Documentation: observation/reflection thresholds, append/cache behavior, buffering and failure policy
Implementation: meetsObservationThreshold lines 1348-1357; replaceOrAppendThreadSection lines 2208-2268; wrapObservations lines 2273-2293; status trigger lines 3150-3155
primary_sources.observed_rule: Observation threshold compares pending plus unobserved message tokens with a configured/dynamic threshold. Reflection compares observation size with its own threshold; buffering and idle/provider options add other activation paths.
primary_sources.retention: Thread-scope wrapObservations returns existing observations followed by a separator and new observations. Resource scope can merge a thread/date section. Reflection rewrites the accumulated observations.
primary_sources.overlap: Direct counterevidence to treating preservation of old compressed text plus appended new observations as a new primitive.
primary_sources.difference: The inspected trigger is backlog/size based, not the repeated paid native-deletion differences E versus prior focus fee C. P140 limits delta to its eligible second opportunity.
primary_sources.accounting_limit: Cache reuse motivates stable prefixes; no full cost or competitive guarantee was established from these sections. Delegated storage/buffering modules and every call path were not audited.

primary_sources.title: Session memory compaction — Claude Cookbook
primary_sources.version: Official rendered page as accessed; mutable, not commit-pinned
viewed_scope: context token usage and cache handling
primary_sources.observed_rule: After a response, compare current context tokens minus tokens at last memory update with a fixed minimum-growth threshold. Initial memory and later context compaction have separate thresholds.
primary_sources.retention: Only new messages are selected for the update, but the demonstration regenerates the entire memory from existing memory plus those messages, then replaces session_memory. Unsummarized messages are retained.
primary_sources.overlap: Proactive incremental updates, token-informed scheduling and cache-conscious summary calls are existing engineering mechanisms.
primary_sources.difference: Current context growth is not a sum of repeated paid prefix exposures, and the trigger does not compare with the last summary input/output charge. This demonstration rewrites memory rather than preserving prior note bytes.
primary_sources.accounting_limit: The example reads response usage and cached input for context size. A complete end-to-end comparison matching P140 logical IO was not established from the inspected code.

primary_sources.title: The Complexity Trap: Simple Observation Masking Is as Efficient as LLM Summarization for Agent Context Management
primary_sources.observed_rule: Summarization is scheduled by accumulated turns, retaining a recent tail; the main implementation uses N=21 summarized turns and M=10 retained turns.
primary_sources.retention: Previous summary and newly eligible turns produce a replacement summary. The actor receives that summary plus recent turns, rather than an immutable sequence of old and delta summaries.
primary_sources.overlap: Summary scheduling, raw-tail retention, a simple masking control and accounting for summary overhead and trajectory elongation are established.
primary_sources.difference: The inspected schedule is turn-count based, not retrospective native-deletion exposure versus the preceding focus bill.
primary_sources.accounting_limit: Provider/cache-sensitive cost analysis is not identical to unpriced logical input plus output. No later-version hybrid trigger or whole implementation was verified.

primary_sources.title: An Empirical Cost Attribution of Context-Compression Gateways in Multi-Turn Coding Agents: Why Compression Rate Is Not the End-to-End Saving
primary_sources.observed_rule: Content compression is enabled by a minimum segment-token floor; history summarization addresses context-window pressure. Repeated resubmission makes local reductions accumulate, while recalls and changed trajectories alter end-to-end savings.
primary_sources.retention: Exact source recall is supported; that is not evidence of immutable prior-summary preservation. The inspected method does not specify such a summary-state rule.
primary_sources.overlap: Cumulative repeated-input cost, non-destructive access, separating compression effects and whole-session attribution are prior concerns.
primary_sources.difference: The inspected methods do not turn the past native-deletion exposure sum into an E >= previous-focus-cost execution predicate.
primary_sources.accounting_limit: Reported bills distinguish provider cache/input/output tiers. Inclusion of every local compressor compute cost was not established; no numerical performance claim is imported.

primary_sources.title: Total Recall at What Cost? Benchmarking the Serving Cost of Agentic Memory Systems
viewed_scope: Sections 3.1 and 3.3, systems and cost model
primary_sources.observed_rule: Break-even is measured after the run: cumulative memory-system cost becomes lower than full history and remains lower at later measured turns. This evaluates systems; it is not an online compaction command.
primary_sources.retention: The benchmark inherits the selected memory systems; it introduces no single immutable-checkpoint/delta update rule in these sections.
primary_sources.overlap: Memory overhead, repeated transcript presentation and cumulative amortization are explicitly studied.
primary_sources.difference: An ex-post cumulative-cost crossing against full history is distinct from deciding now using E and the last focus charge C.
primary_sources.accounting_limit: The fitted cost variable sums input across ingest/retrieval/answer and tracks output separately. Cost dialogues and recall-accuracy tasks are separate benchmarks, unlike one task final-success/whole-job pair.

assessment.closest_new_representation_overlap: Pinned Mastra thread-scope append path is a concrete close match to keeping existing compressed text and adding new text. Its reflection/resource paths also prevent an overbroad claim that all Mastra state is immutable.
assessment.meaning_of_negative_search: Only the inspected methods lack a confirmed exact E/C predicate. This is neither an absence proof nor evidence that the rule or its combination is novel.
assessment.supportable_difference: The precise retrospective native-deletion positive-part accumulator and previous-known-focus threshold can be described as a concrete implementation-level control difference from these inspected backlog, fixed-interval and ex-post accounting mechanisms.
assessment.combination_judgment: The representation component substantially overlaps existing append-oriented memory. Combining it with a specific observed-cost heuristic remains an unestablished novelty hypothesis; a new formula or two existing components together do not by themselves establish a research contribution.
assessment.not_ski_rental_guarantee: E measures past count-only deletion exposure, not achievable future summary savings. C is a previous charge, not a bound on the next one; trajectory and representation can change. Competitive ratio, payback and quality preservation do not follow.
assessment.controls_not_mechanism_novelty: Complete role accounting, native-shorter acceptance, matched-prefix checks and four-arm attribution controls can strengthen an empirical comparison but are not themselves proof of a novel memory mechanism.
assessment.scope: Known development tasks at the selected seed and maximum two opportunities; no broad noninferiority, statistical timing-by-representation synergy, independent replication, first-method or held-out claim is supported by this literature note.
